model.boundary: all six faces natural traction-free; rigid motions projected out
model.geometry: equal-area free square surrogate for 24-mm disk; central 10-mm square beam; mounting/shape not measured operator inputs
model.grain_maps: synthetic columnar piecewise rotated cubic; no measured grain map
model.source: independent Poisson positive/negative parents in 36 equal-area sites; electrical fractions .85/.15; D2 two recoil energies share one parent sign
model.packet: effective z-traction point at host-deposition weighted mean depth; fixed retained-band energy per parent; terminal_depth_A is stored in METRES despite key
model.source_time: bin-boundary impulse approximation; no conditioning/window reweighting; no time compression
model.localization: positive quartic of center epsilon_xx at depth 30um couples retained foil modes; localized receiver sensitivity, not measured full-foil nonlinearity
model.thermal: classical same-band strain quadratic form; mean kBT Tr(A)/2; sd kBT sqrt(Tr(A²)/2); finite modal correlations retained

result.statistical_scope: fixed center receivers plus explicit 16-receiver union; union amplitudes normalized to its own mean; no extrapolated spatial event count
result.first_refinement: band-resolved launch and acoustic loss/transfer; nonlinear coefficient is not measured
